meta.title: 500万以下不用理财：只做定期
meta.title_en: No Investing Needed Under 5 Million: Just Fixed Deposits

scenes.context: 讲者给出核心结论：500万之前不需要理财，纯定期即可，买股票基金、资产配置、理财课都不需要；中国市场无风险收益只有 2.3%-2.4%，从 2.3% 加两个点做到 4.3% 需要冒很大风险。
sentences: 500万之前你不需要理财，纯定期就可以了。
You don't need investing before five million—fixed deposits are just fine.
纯定期：plain fixed deposits
目前中国市场无风险收益大概2.3%、2.4%的样子。
Right now, risk-free returns in China are around 2.3% to 2.4%.
无风险收益：risk-free return
从2.3%的基础上加两个点做到4.3%，你需要冒多大的风险。
Going from 2.3% up two points to 4.3%—how much risk would that take?
加两个点：add two percentage points
paraphrase: 钱少 → 不需要资产配置
Small money means no need for asset allocation.
收益空间被无风险利率锁定
Return upside is capped by the risk-free rate.
scenes.speak: You don't need investing before five million—fixed deposits are just fine. Right now, risk-free returns in China are around 2.3% to 2.4%. Going from 2.3% up two points to 4.3%—how much risk would that take?

scenes.title_cn: 两个点只差10万，精力留给主业
scenes.title_en: Two points is just 100k; save your energy for work
scenes.context: 讲者算账：500万的两个点是 10 万块，用心理财与只存银行一年最多差 10 万；不如把这心思用在本职工作上，升职加薪一年也能多 10 万，而研究理财反而挤占画图、写报告、做PPT的时间。
sentences: 500万的两个点是多少钱？10万块。
What are two points on five million? A hundred thousand yuan.
两个点：two percentage points
理财非常用心、运气还不错的人，跟完全不理财只存银行的人，收益最多差10万块。
Someone who invests with real dedication and decent luck beats a pure bank-saver by at most a hundred thousand.
最多差：differ by at most
你有这个心思去做本职工作，好好上班、升职加薪，一年10万块算不到吗？
Put that energy into your day job—work hard, get promoted and raises—can't you make a hundred thousand a year that way?
升职加薪：get promoted and raises
paraphrase: 差异收益折成绝对值 → 不值得
Convert the difference to absolute terms—it's not worth it.
理财的隐性成本是主业时间
The hidden cost of investing is your job time.
scenes.speak: What are two points on five million? A hundred thousand yuan. Someone who invests with real dedication and decent luck beats a pure bank-saver by at most a hundred thousand. Put that energy into your day job—work hard, get promoted and raises—can't you make a hundred thousand a year that way?

scenes.context: 讲者收尾划定门槛：500万之前赚两个点毫无意义，理财从 500 万开始；有 5000 万一年能多赚 100 万才需要精通，而只有 10 万的年轻人请吃顿饭都不值 2000 块，别谈理财。
sentences: 500万之前，你去赚两个点的差异、赚10万块，毫无意义。
Before five million, chasing a two-point edge and an extra hundred thousand is pointless.
毫无意义：pointless
你要是有5000万，一年就可以多赚100万，那你就需要精通。
If you had fifty million, you could make an extra million a year—then you'd need real expertise.
精通：real expertise
年轻人10万块钱还跟我说理财呢。
A young person with a hundred thousand is still asking me about investing.
10万块钱：a hundred thousand
paraphrase: 本金越大，理财越值得精通
The more wealth you have, the more investing is worth mastering.
A hundred thousand is just not worth the effort.
scenes.speak: Before five million, chasing a two-point edge and an extra hundred thousand is pointless. If you had fifty million, you could make an extra million a year—then you'd need real expertise. A young person with a hundred thousand is still asking me about investing.

practice: Fixed deposits are more than enough for now.
The gap is at most a hundred thousand a year.
表达「把精力放在本职工作上」
Put that energy into your day job.
Investing only becomes worthwhile at the five-million mark.
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：You don't need to manage money before 5 million.
✓ 地道说法：You don't need to invest before five million—fixed deposits are just fine.
manage money 是中式搭配，英文里谈投资用 invest 更自然。
✓ 地道说法：Two percentage points on five million is a hundred thousand yuan.
two points 单独说容易歧义，需要带本金基数。
✓ 地道说法：Get promoted and get raises.
promote 与 raise 是固定搭配，且 raise 作「加薪」通常是复数。
✕ 直译腔：You have this heart to do your own work.
✓ 地道说法：Put that energy into your day job.
「有这个心思」直译生硬，用 put energy into 更地道。
shifts: 有钱就该学理财、追求最高收益
钱少时纯定期就够，收益被无风险利率锁死
把精力投给本职工作，升职加薪才是正路
理财从500万开始，5000万才需要精通
